title: Altinn Studio — Reports and alerts
description: The periodic reports and the alerts Altinn Studio Designer (service studio-designer) sends to service owners' contact points (email, SMS and Slack), and the alerts it posts to the Studio team's Slack channel. Counts come from Designer's counters altinn.designer.periodic_report.reports and altinn.designer.notification.deliveries (altinn-studio-metrics), which are not sampled; a failure carries error.type. Sent means Altinn Notifications accepted the order, or the Slack webhook answered with success. Whether an email or SMS then reached the recipient is known only to Altinn Notifications. Service owner and Runtime environment filter the metric panels; the trace table at the bottom, from Designer's spans through altinn-studio-traces-logsql, has its own Filters. Notifications about failed deploys are counted with kind deployment and are not shown here. Totals use increase_pure() over the range, which also counts a counter's first increment.

list.name: service_owner
list.label: Service owner
list.description: Service owner the report or alert is for (altinn.service_owner). Filters the metric panels.

list.name: target_env
list.label: Runtime environment
list.description: Runtime environment the report or alert is about (altinn.environment), such as tt02 or prod. Filters the metric panels.

list.name: filters
list.label: Filters
list.description: Filters the trace table (LogsQL) on any span field, such as span_attr:altinn.service_owner or span_attr:altinn.designer.notification.kind. The metric panels are not filtered.

panels.title: Reports sent
panels.description: Periodic reports sent in the time range: one per service owner, environment and frequency, counted when every subscribed contact method accepted it.

panels.title: Reports failed
panels.description: Periodic reports that failed in the time range: the report could not be put together, or at least one subscribed contact method did not accept it. The others still got it. Reports by service owner and environment, and Recent failed reports and deliveries, show which.

panels.title: Report deliveries sent
panels.description: Deliveries of periodic reports, one per contact method, that Altinn Notifications or Slack accepted. For email and SMS, accepted is not delivered: Altinn Notifications sends them afterwards and knows whether they arrived.

panels.title: Report deliveries failed
panels.description: Deliveries of periodic reports, one per contact method, that Altinn Notifications or Slack did not accept.

panels.title: Reports by frequency
panels.description: Periodic reports per frequency, sent and failed, per bar interval. Daily reports go out at 07:00, weekly ones on Mondays and monthly ones on the 1st, Norwegian time.

panels.title: Report deliveries by contact method
panels.description: Deliveries of periodic reports per contact method, accepted and failed, per bar interval.

panels.title: Reports by service owner and environment
panels.description: Periodic reports and their deliveries over the time range, per service owner and runtime environment. Sorted by failed reports; select a column header to sort by another.

panels.title: Alerts notified
panels.description: Firing alerts Designer notified about in the time range. Each one is posted once to the Studio team's Slack channel, so this counts those posts, failed or not.

panels.title: Alert deliveries sent
panels.description: Deliveries of alerts to service owners, one per contact method, that Altinn Notifications or Slack accepted. For email and SMS, accepted is not delivered.

panels.title: Alert deliveries failed
panels.description: Deliveries of alerts to service owners, one per contact method, that Altinn Notifications or Slack did not accept.

panels.title: Internal Slack posts failed
panels.description: Alerts that could not be posted to the Studio team's Slack channel.

panels.title: Alerts by service owner
panels.description: Firing alerts Designer notified about, per service owner, per bar interval.

panels.title: Alert deliveries by contact method
panels.description: Deliveries of alerts per contact method, accepted and failed, per bar interval. internal is the post to the Studio team's Slack channel.

panels.title: Alerts by service owner and environment
panels.description: Alerts and their deliveries over the time range, per service owner and runtime environment. Sorted by alerts; select a column header to sort by another.

panels.title: Recent failed reports and deliveries
panels.description: The latest failed reports, deliveries to service owners and posts to the internal Slack channel, newest first, from Designer's spans through altinn-studio-traces-logsql (LogsQL). Notifications about failed deploys are left out. Tail sampling keeps every trace with an error, so the list is complete. A report that failed because a delivery failed is listed together with that delivery; the exception on the delivery is the cause. Filter the list with Filters above, such as span_attr:altinn.service_owner. Select a trace to open it.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="studio-designer"} "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":$env name:in("PeriodicReportJob.SendReport", "NotificationService.SendContactMethodAsync", "NotificationService.NotifyInternalAsync") status_code:2 !"span_attr:altinn.designer.notification.kind":=deployment | sort by (_time desc) limit 500 | fields _time, name, "span_attr:altinn.designer.notification.kind", "span_attr:altinn.service_owner", "span_attr:altinn.environment", "span_attr:altinn.designer.notification.contact_method.type", "event:event_attr:exception.type:0", "event:event_attr:exception.message:0", trace_id | rename trace_id as trace
